text: {"lessons":["Repeatedly selling winners for quick satisfaction can leave too little invested in them; set position and profit-taking rules before trading.","Selling Stock C at a loss showed I can act despite the pain; judge every holding by its prospects, not by my purchase price or reluctance to admit a mistake.","I added to Stock B at rising prices; before buying more, check that the investment case still holds and that the position size fits my plan."]}
